Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.base.conditions

Class SelectionPreCondition

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.base.conditions.SelectionPreCondition
All Implemented Interfaces:
PreCommandExecution
public class SelectionPreCondition extends Object implements PreCommandExecution
A concrete implementation of PreCommandExecution which forces the user to have made a selection before the command can execute.

This implementation provides:

  • KeyEvent.VK_ENTER and KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE to abort the selection requirement
  • a direct implementation of getPassListener(), getFailListener(), getCondition(), getLogText() and getEventEmitterToAttachTo()
  • a singleton Runnable which executes the code when this passes
  • a singleton commandEndCleanup Runnable to otherwise provide extra cleanup that is required by the command

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
